requirement: Implement a safe Model Context Protocol (MCP) file resource provider that enforces directory containment, canonical path resolution, regular file verification, and maximum file size limits.
skeleton: SafeMCPResourceProvider with read_resource and is_path_safe methods returning MCPResourceContent.

rationale.teaches: A file resource provider that resolves the candidate path and checks containment with is_relative_to, rejects absolute components, enforces a size limit inclusively, and reads UTF-8 text.
rationale.why: Path traversal only shows with a crafted relative path like ../secret or a sibling directory sharing the root's prefix. The fixture creates both and expects PermissionError.

candidates.why_wrong: Containment is checked by string prefix, so a sibling directory named root_dir2 passes as inside root_dir.
The traversal check is dropped, so ../ paths read files outside the root.
A file exactly at the size limit is rejected, so the documented maximum is not readable.
max_file_size defaults to 1000 bytes, so ordinary text files are rejected by default.
Files are decoded as latin1 and labeled octet-stream, so UTF-8 content is corrupted.
